title: Row transformation is polynomial-time computable
statement: The function on bit strings defined by the row transformation in which the input components are successively decoded into a matrix parameter, a modulus, and two auxiliary strings; the modulus is computed from the binary values of the encoded operands, and the resulting paired data are processed by the prescribed zip iteration and entry transformation, is polynomial-time computable.
caveat: The component transformations used in the definition are present only as Lean definitions, without informal descriptions in the supplied context; this summary cannot fully specify their arithmetic and iteration details.
